jobs.title: Principal, Program Manager
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Job Description:
Your role:
Ingram Micro is seeking experienced Principal, Program Manager – Agile Delivery who can lead Program delivery with a lean-agile mindset. They must be quick learners and love challenging themselves to constantly raise the bar. This opportunity requires strong problem-solving skills, an aptitude for team leadership and effective communication and collaboration across stakeholders as they deliver efficient, well-designed, and sophisticated software systems for positive user experience.
The Agile program management role will be establishing and executing all aspects of the program management function for the large-scale, complex global digital program. This includes a portfolio of medium- to large-sized projects that are delivered across the Ingram global landscape.
This position will effectively lead the program and engineering teams to deliver solutions that involve a combination of the following attributes: large-scale program investments, multiple project teams, multiple technology disciplines, global or multiple region geographic deliveries, geographically disbursed delivery teams, and/or the highest-level technical complexity. The program management function includes, but is not limited to: Program Leadership, Planning & Administration, and Execution Integration.
This position must have a mastery and proven prior experience working on a variety of digital programs/projects to succeed within the high-paced environment of Ingram Micro’s Global Digital team. It is expected that the result of this position will be the delivery of an efficient and effective solution or series of solutions resulting in a competitive advantage for the company. A program is defined as a solution delivery team that is made up of multiple project teams all focused on delivering a single solution whose scope is large.
What you bring to the role:
- A Bachelor's degree is required, preferred in Computer Science/Engineering is required.
- Minimum of 8 years of demonstrated experience in combined program and project management delivery.
- Hands-on experience implementing enterprise-level software applications in a fast-paced environment with an ability to manage multiple functional areas simultaneously
- Experience leading large cross-functional teams and driving consensus among colleagues; the ability to lead, motivate, influence, and drive results in a highly matrixed environment is essential.
- Demonstrated strong leadership and have led program team members.
- Relationship management experience within an enterprise globally, among executives, customers, and staff; as well as externally with vendors and business partners as required.
- Experience in evaluating a broad range of internal and external factors when solving problems and making decisions; prioritizes team efforts to support critical, business growth-driven initiatives
- Complex problem resolution and ability to merge diverse technology agendas into a cohesive, integrated digital and eCommerce solution by influencing key technology resources.
- Ability to conduct and interpret qualitative and quantitative analysis and problem-solving skills and show independent judgment and creative problem-solving techniques in a highly complex environment.
- Establish relevant and comprehensive program performance-related metrics that highlight, not only the overall health of the project
- Collaborate with internal and external teams to maintain alignment toward program milestones.
- Drive process improvement to increase team efficiency. Curate internal training content and process documentation to keep teams aligned on standard operating procedures, guardrails, and best practices.
- Handling aspects of technical projects for their organization, responsible for initiating programs, following their progress, and serving as support providers in case issues arise.
- Manage Portfolio and program with constant communication with stakeholders, escalate impediments, help manage risk, and drive relentless improvement.
- Track project performance across scope, schedule, budget, and benefits realization.
- Maintain the enterprise project portfolio dashboard and provide insights to leadership.
- Support portfolio planning, prioritization, and resource allocation.
- Prince2/PMP Certification required
- Agile certification and understanding of SAFe methodologies required
- Superior communication skills, both written and oral.

Specialized Knowledge & Skills:
- 5+ years of experience with eCommerce/distribution domain
- Experience with Engineering and Implementing enterprise level software applications
- Experience with Agile Management Tools (i.e., Confluence, JIRA, VersionOne)
- Experience with leading global cross-functional program teams
- Good skills and knowledge of servant leadership, facilitation, situational awareness, conflict resolution, continual improvement, empowerment, and increasing transparency.
- Knowledge of other Agile approaches: XP, Kanban, Crystal, FDD, etc.
- Awareness and experience with widely successful Agile techniques: User Stories, ATDD, TDD, Continuous Integration, Continuous Testing, Pairing, Automated Testing, Agile Games.
- Understand incremental delivery and the value of metrics
- Familiarity with common Agile practices, service-oriented environments, and better development practices
- Understand backlog tracking, burndown metrics, velocity, and task definition
- Program Management: SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle), resource planning, MS Projects
- Proficient with MS Office Applications - Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Visio, Adobe Applications, Project Management tools
- Knowledge of commonly used databases such as Microsoft SQL, Oracle, and Big Query

jobs.title: General Manager - HPE
jobs.description:

Job Description:
GM HPE - Hybrid Role

OVERVIEW

Lead and drive the overall HPE business to maximize revenue growth, profitability, market share, and business performance in alignment with Ingram Micro’s strategic objectives and HPE’s business priorities.

This person is responsible for setting and executing the overall HPE business strategy, covering sales, marketing, pricing, inventory, channel development, and go-to-market initiatives. The role owns the overall financial performance and P&L of the HPE business and works closely with HPE, internal teams, and channel partners to identify growth opportunities and deliver sustainable business results.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Have overall responsibility for the HPE business strategy and business performance , including revenue, gross profit, profitability, and market growth.
• Develop and execute the overall Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy for HPE, covering sales, marketing, pricing, inventory, channel development, and business growth initiatives.
• Own the overall P&L and financial performance of the HPE business, ensuring business plans and financial targets are achieved.
• Lead, manage, and develop the HPE sales and business organization to achieve business objectives and performance targets.
• Build and maintain strong strategic relationships with HPE, key partners, resellers, and customers , acting as a senior point of contact for strategic business matters.
• Work closely with HPE to develop joint business plans, identify market opportunities, and drive strategic initiatives to expand HPE’s market presence.
• Identify new business opportunities, emerging technologies, and growth areas across the HPE portfolio, including Compute, Storage, Networking, Hybrid Cloud, and HPE GreenLake .
• Lead strategic negotiations with HPE and key partners to secure favorable commercial terms, pricing, incentives, and business agreements.
• Monitor and manage sales pipeline, forecasting, market share, inventory, and overall business performance.
• Work closely with Product Management, Sales, Presales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to ensure seamless execution of the HPE business strategy.
• Oversee marketing initiatives, promotions, and demand generation activities to drive business growth and channel engagement.
• Analyze market trends, competitive landscape, customer needs, and business insights to identify opportunities and adjust business strategies accordingly.
• Ensure strong execution and accountability across the organization to achieve agreed business objectives and financial targets.
• Represent Ingram Micro in strategic vendor, partner, and industry meetings and events.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS
• Strong knowledge of the IT technology and distribution industry , with a deep understanding of HPE’s portfolio and solutions.
• Strong understanding of HPE Compute, Storage, Networking, Hybrid Cloud, and HPE GreenLake is preferred.
• Proven business and financial acumen with experience managing P&L, revenue, gross profit, and profitability .
• Strong leadership skills with the ability to lead, motivate, and develop high-performing sales and business teams.
• Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong strategic thinking and ability to develop and execute comprehensive business plans.
• Strong understanding of channel business, reseller ecosystem, and partner management .
• Results-oriented mindset with a proven track record of achieving and exceeding business objectives.
• Ability to analyze market and business data and translate insights into actionable strategies.
• Ability to work collaboratively across functions and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Willingness to travel for vendor meetings, partner engagements, customer meetings, and industry events.

REQUIREMENTS
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA is preferred.
• 8+ years of experience in IT sales, business development, vendor management, distribution, or related technology industries.
• Proven experience in a senior leadership role managing a large business, sales organization, or technology portfolio.
• Strong experience managing revenue, P&L, gross profit, forecasting, and overall business performance .
• Strong experience working with HPE and/or other leading technology vendors in an IT distribution, channel, or System Integrator environment.
• Proven track record of developing and executing Go-to-Market strategies and driving business growth.
• Strong network and relationships with IT channel partners, resellers, and enterprise customers .
• Experience leading and developing sales and business teams.
• Excellent command of English and strong communication skills.

COMPETENCIES
• Strategic Mindset: Sees ahead to identify future opportunities and translates them into clear business strategies.
• Financial Acumen: Uses financial and business performance indicators to make sound commercial decisions and drive profitability.
• Business Insight: Applies deep knowledge of the IT market, technology trends, and channel ecosystem to advance business growth.
• Leadership: Inspires, develops, and leads teams to achieve ambitious business and financial objectives.
• Manages Complexity: Makes effective decisions in complex and fast-changing business environments.
• Collaborates: Builds strong partnerships across internal teams, vendors, partners, and customers.
• Builds Networks: Develops strong executive-level relationships across internal and external stakeholders.
• Communicates Effectively: Clearly communicates strategy, priorities, and business objectives to different audiences.
• Drives Results: Consistently delivers strong business performance and achieves agreed targets.
• Ensures Accountability: Establishes clear expectations and holds self and others accountable for delivering results.

Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem. Reporting directly to the   Regional IMFS Lead, APAC , this role serves as the commercial lead for IMFS across the ANZ market. The successful candidate will   be responsible for   expanding the local financing business by developing strategic relationships with technology vendors, resellers, funding   partners   and end users, while originating and converting financing opportunities that strengthen Ingram Micro's value proposition.

This is a highly autonomous business development role suited to an experienced commercial professional who enjoys building relationships,   identifying   opportunities   and delivering business growth. Supported by regional specialists in strategic funding partnerships, transaction structuring, governance and operational execution, the Business Manager will lead local market development, manage day-to-day engagement with local funding partners, and drive the continued growth of IMFS across ANZ.

Key Responsibilities

ANZ Business Growth & Market Development

- Drive the growth and adoption of IMFS across Australia and New Zealand by developing a sustainable pipeline of financing opportunities.

- Develop and execute country growth strategies aligned with regional   objectives , increasing financing penetration through technology vendors,   resellers   and end-user opportunities.

- Identify   emerging market opportunities, industry   trends   and financing initiatives to support the continued expansion of IMFS across the ANZ market.

Business Development & Customer Engagement

- Develop trusted relationships with Ingram Micro sales teams, technology vendors,   resellers   and end users to originate and convert financing opportunities.

- Engage key decision-makers across reseller and end-user organisations, including business owners, procurement leaders, finance   executives   and C-suite stakeholders, to understand business priorities and position IMFS as a strategic commercial solution.

- Own opportunity development, stakeholder   engagement   and commercial progression throughout the sales lifecycle.

Vendor & Funding Partner Management

- Develop and strengthen strategic relationships with technology vendors to increase awareness,   adoption   and utilisation of IMFS.

- Partner with vendor sales, channel and alliance teams to integrate IMFS into go-to-market initiatives,   identify   financing opportunities and increase financing adoption through reseller channels.

- Develop and   maintain   day-to-day relationships with local funding partners, acting as the primary commercial liaison to support financing opportunities, transaction   execution   and commercial collaboration.

- Collaborate with the Regional IMFS team to   leverage   strategic vendor programmes and funding partnerships while   identifying   opportunities to expand financing programmes and commercial capabilities within ANZ.

- Represent IMFS in vendor and funding partner business reviews, joint account planning, partner   events   and strategic customer engagements.

Sales Enablement & Market Development

- Champion IMFS through sales enablement activities, customer presentations, partner   workshops   and market awareness initiatives.

- Provide financing   expertise , commercial guidance and market insights that enable sales teams and resellers to confidently position IMFS and   identify   new business opportunities.

- Support financing-led initiatives that increase financing penetration, drive reseller   adoption   and generate sustainable pipeline growth.

Regional Collaboration & Opportunity Execution

- Partner with regional IMFS specialists on complex opportunities, funding strategies, transaction   structuring   and programme implementation.

- Coordinate internal and external stakeholders to ensure efficient opportunity progression,   timely   execution   and an exceptional customer experience.

- Share market intelligence, funding partner   feedback   and ecosystem insights to support regional growth initiatives and continuous improvement.

Business Planning & Performance Management

- Maintain ownership of pipeline management, CRM,   forecasting   and business reporting, ensuring data integrity, forecast accuracy and   timely   progression of opportunities.

- Provide regular updates on business performance, strategic opportunities, market   developments   and financing activities while ensuring compliance with internal governance, commercial   policies   and reporting requirements.

Who We Are Looking For

- Bachelor's Degree in Business , Finance, Commerce,   Economics   or a related discipline.

- At least 10 years' experience in technology financing, vendor finance, equipment finance, IT distribution, channel sales, business   development   or related industries.

- Strong understanding of the ANZ technology ecosystem, including technology vendors, value-added resellers (VARs), managed service providers (MSPs), systems integrators (SIs), channel go-to-market   models   and technology financing.

- Proven ability to develop strategic relationships, originate new business opportunities and consistently deliver commercial growth.

- Demonstrated success engaging and influencing senior decision-makers, including business owners, procurement leaders, finance   executives   and C-suite stakeholders.

- Strong commercial acumen with experience managing complex commercial opportunities involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.

- Excellent communication, presentation,   negotiation   and stakeholder management skills.

- Self-motivated,   entrepreneurial   and able to work independently within a matrix organisation.

- Experience in technology financing, vendor finance, equipment leasing, financial   services   or IT distribution will be highly regarded.

- Willingness to travel across Australia and New Zealand as   required .

What Success Looks Like

Job Description:
Join us at the forefront!

Who We Are

We are the business behind the world's brands. We're Ingram Micro—a people-first technology partner reaching nearly 90% of the world's population, with operations in 57 countries and approximately 24,000 associates. We're redefining distribution.

Our Operations team in the UAE is at the heart of Ingram Micro's ability to deliver on its promise to partners and customers across the region. Collaborating with Sales, Finance, Procurement, and Customer Service, the team ensures products reach businesses efficiently—helping them thrive in one of the world's most dynamic markets.

In the UAE, this team focuses on optimising warehouse and logistics routes to meet the unique demands of our high-growth, multinational environment. By joining Operations, you will play a pivotal role in positioning Ingram Micro as the go-to partner for businesses across the Middle East and beyond.

Our Values in Action

At Ingram Micro, we are shaping the future with cutting-edge technology. Join us and thrive in a diverse, values-driven environment that celebrates growth, learning, and inclusivity. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement—where integrity, imagination, courage, responsibility, and talent flourish.

Our team members are encouraged to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and work together to build the future of technology distribution. It works when we work together.

What You'll Do

As Operations Manager - Warehouse , you will lead warehouse operations within a high-volume distribution center, ensuring operational excellence, inventory accuracy, and exceptional service delivery.

- Lead end-to-end warehouse operations, including receiving, put-away, storage, inventory control, picking, packing, and order fulfillment activities.
- Drive inventory accuracy and warehouse performance through effective stock management, cycle counting, KPI monitoring, and process compliance.
- Lead, coach, and develop warehouse supervisors and associates, fostering a culture of safety, accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement.
- Optimize warehouse productivity through efficient labor planning, space utilization, workflow improvement, and Lean-based operational excellence initiatives.
- Leverage WMS, ERP systems, and operational reporting to improve visibility, support data-driven decisions, and ensure achievement of service and operational targets.

What You Bring to the Role

Your strengths, our vision. We're looking for an experienced operations leader who brings:

- Relevant industry experience:  Approximately 8 years of experience leading warehouse and logistics operations, ideally in a multinational or regional distribution environment.

- Leadership experience:  A proven track record of leading large, diverse operations teams—including supervisors and frontline staff—through periods of growth and change.

- Role-specific experience:  Demonstrated success managing 3PL relationships, inventory governance, and compliance within a regulated, fast-paced environment.

- Technical skills:  Proficiency with WMS, ERP systems, and digital productivity tools; comfort working with data and reporting platforms to inform decisions.

- Education:  A bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or a related field. An MBA, CSCP, or equivalent professional certification is a strong advantage.

Expectations — How You'll Succeed

To thrive in this role and grow with us, you will demonstrate these key competencies:
- Relevant industry experience: Approximately 8 years of experience managing large-scale warehouse operations, distribution centers, or fulfillment environments, ideally within a multinational organization.
- Leadership experience: Proven experience leading warehouse teams, including supervisors, team leaders, and operational associates, while driving performance, engagement, and operational excellence.
- Role-specific experience: Demonstrated success in inventory management, warehouse optimization, stock control, cycle counting, workforce planning, and distribution center operations.
- Technical skills: Strong knowledge of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), ERP platforms, inventory control processes, and warehouse performance reporting.
- Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field. Professional certifications in warehouse operations, Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement are advantageous.

Your Growth With Us

Joining Ingram Micro means becoming part of a global leader in technology solutions. We offer a dynamic work environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to make a significant impact on the future of technology distribution across the Middle East and beyond.

At Ingram Micro, we invest in your future. Through continuous learning, leadership development, and a commitment to fostering innovation, we ensure every team member thrives in their career journey.

Let's shape tomorrow together.

#LI-SMR1

Position Summary
The Warehouse Operations Lead provides frontline leadership for daily distribution center activities and supports Warehouse Associates in achieving safety, quality, productivity, inventory accuracy, and customer service goals. This hands-on role coordinates labor and product flow, monitors operational performance, removes barriers, supports training, and maintains an organized, high-performing work environment. Working closely with Warehouse Supervisors, the Lead communicates priorities, reinforces standard operating procedures, and drives accountability and continuous improvement across receiving, processing, sortation, inventory movement, packing, and shipping operations.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead, motivate, and support Warehouse Associates in meeting daily safety, quality, productivity, attendance, and customer service expectations.
- Communicate shift priorities, work assignments, performance goals, safety topics, and operational updates.
- Monitor productivity, throughput, labor utilization, quality, and inventory accuracy; provide real-time feedback and recognition.
- Coordinate staffing and workflow across receiving, processing, sortation, inventory movement, packing, and shipping activities.
- Identify and resolve workflow bottlenecks and escalate equipment, staffing, safety, quality, or process issues when needed.
- Ensure associates follow standard operating procedures, work instructions, quality requirements, and company policies.
- Conduct safety observations, address unsafe conditions, and reinforce proper material-handling practices.
- Support onboarding, job training, cross-training, and skills development for new and existing team members.
- Partner with Warehouse Supervisors to address performance gaps and reinforce accountability, engagement, and teamwork.
- Maintain clean, organized, and audit-ready work areas by reinforcing 5S and housekeeping standards.
- Support cycle counts, inventory accuracy activities, and the proper storage and handling of inventory and materials.
- Participate in continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, capacity, quality, and workforce readiness.

Required Skills and Qualifications
- High school diploma, GED, or equivalent.
- 2+ years of experience in warehouse operations, distribution, logistics, manufacturing, material handling, or a related operational environment.
- Working knowledge of warehouse functions such as receiving, processing, sortation, inventory movement, packing, and shipping.
- Experience monitoring productivity, throughput, quality, or other operational performance metrics.
- Ability to lead by example, communicate expectations, provide coaching, and support team accountability.
- Strong communication, interpersonal, organization, and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to prioritize work, adjust assignments, and respond to changing operational demands in a fast-paced environment.
- Basic computer skills and experience using warehouse systems, RF devices, or similar technology.
- Commitment to workplace safety, quality, attendance, inventory accuracy, and customer service standards.
- Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and lift or move products in accordance with site and company safety requirements.

Preferred Skills and Qualifications
- Associate degree in business, logistics, supply chain, operations, or a related field.
- Previous experience as a warehouse lead, team lead, trainer, coordinator, or informal frontline leader.
- Experience in a high-volume distribution center or fulfillment environment.
- Experience using a warehouse management system (WMS), RF scanners, inventory systems, and Microsoft Office applications.
- Experience supporting staffing plans, labor allocation, productivity targets, cycle counts, or inventory control activities.
- Knowledge of 5S, Lean, continuous improvement, visual management, or operational excellence practices.
- Experience onboarding, training, cross-training, or developing warehouse employees.

The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $49,500.00 - $79,200.00 per year.

jobs.description:
Accelerate your career. Join the organization that's driving the world's technology and shape the future.

Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem. With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business-to-business technology experts. Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart. Learn more at www.ingrammicro.com

Come join our team where you’ll make technology happen in surprising ways. Let’s shape tomorrow - it’ll be a fun journey!

Ingram Micro is seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager who can leverage their expertise to lead complex digital and technology initiatives with a Lean-Agile mindset. This individual contributor role is responsible for driving the planning, coordination, and execution of cross-functional programs that support strategic business objectives across the Global Digital organization.
The Senior Program Manager partners closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Business, and Operations stakeholders to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions that enhance customer and user experiences. The role requires strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills, as well as the ability to manage competing priorities, mitigate risks, and drive alignment across globally distributed teams.

The successful candidate will oversee medium-to-large technology programs involving multiple stakeholders, interconnected workstreams, and complex dependencies. Success in this role is measured by the ability to deliver business outcomes, maintain execution excellence, and continuously improve delivery processes within a fast-paced and evolving environment.

Your Role:

- Plan, coordinate, and execute cross-functional technology and digital programs from initiation through delivery.
- Partner with Product Managers, Engineering teams, Architecture, and business stakeholders to define program objectives, scope, timelines, and success metrics.
- Facilitate Agile ceremonies, program increment planning, and program governance activities as appropriate.
- Manage program schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, and issues to ensure successful delivery.
- Track and communicate program status, progress, and key performance indicators to stakeholders.
- Drive stakeholder alignment and facilitate decision-making across multiple teams.
- Identify opportunities to improve processes, delivery practices, and team effectiveness.
- Support release planning and execution activities across interconnected project teams.
- Maintain accurate project documentation, reporting, and communication plans.
- Escalate critical issues and risks while proposing actionable mitigation strategies.
- Promote Agile and Lean best practices across delivery teams.

What You Bring to the Role:

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field required.
- 5 - 8 years of experience in program management, project management, or related technology delivery roles.
- Experience leading medium-to-large technology programs and cross-functional initiatives.
- Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across business and technical teams without direct authority.
- Experience managing project schedules, risks, dependencies, and program governance activities.
- Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies, including Scrum and SAFe.
- Experience implementing or supporting enterprise software, digital, eCommerce, or business transformation initiatives.
- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience developing executive-level status reports, dashboards, and program communications.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Agile certification required; SAFe certification preferred.
- PMP or PRINCE2 certification preferred.

Specialized Knowledge & Skills:

- Experience supporting eCommerce, distribution, supply chain, or digital platforms preferred.
- Working knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies.
- Experience with Agile tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
- Understanding of release management, dependency management, and Agile metrics.
- Familiarity with cloud-based and web application environments.
- Knowledge of backlog management, sprint planning, velocity tracking, and reporting.
- Strong facilitation, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
- Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and Visio.
- Ability to analyze data and present insights to drive informed decision-making.
- Experience working in matrixed and globally distributed environments preferred.
